# EX-aero Emissions Mapping Engine Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build, compile, and verify a dynamic, GPU-portable, and stateless Emissions Mapping Engine for EX-aero, enabling CCPP, CATChem, and CECE to map and re-bin 3D grid emissions with dynamic unit scaling and modal mass-to-number conversions.

**Architecture:** We will extend the `exaero::IAerosolPackage` public interface with dynamic emissions views and a stateless translation method. Pointers representing raw emissions from CECE are wrapped into standard layout-left `mdspan` views, which map zero-copy to unmanaged Kokkos Views. A GPU parallel kernel (`GocartEmissionsKernel`) will evaluate unit scalings ($\text{kg/m}^2/\text{s} \to \text{kg/m}^3/\text{s}$) via layer thicknesses, perform fractional mapping, and convert mass to lognormal particle number concentration on-the-fly.

**Tech Stack:** C++20, Kokkos, `yaml-cpp`, C/Fortran ISO_C_BINDINGS bindings.

## Global Constraints

*   **Zero-Dependency Public API:** Public headers must require zero external host headers (only C++20 standard library, `mdspan`, and Kokkos).
*   **Target-Level Compiler Isolation:** Public C++ interfaces and binding layers compile without any Kokkos compiler flags or header search paths.
*   **Statelessness:** The engine does not store state; it writes computed results directly to a host-managed output buffer.
*   **HPC Memory Safety:** Every input view must be wrapped zero-copy and zero-allocation. All division operations must prevent division-by-zero, and NaNs/Infs must be clamped.

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement YAML parsing in `GocartPackage.cpp`**

Update the YAML reader loop inside `GocartPackage::initialize` to parse `emissions_mapping` configurations and copy the parameters to the device-space parameters array:

```cpp
        // Inside GocartPackage::initialize parsing
        if (config["emissions_mapping"]) {
            auto mapping_node = config["emissions_mapping"];
            for (size_t s = 0; s < mapping_node.size(); ++s) {
                std::string raw_name = mapping_node[s]["raw_name"].as<std::string>();
                int raw_cece_idx = static_cast<int>(s); // map indices sequentially
                
                auto mappings = mapping_node[s]["mappings"];
                for (size_t m = 0; m < mappings.size(); ++m) {
                    std::string target_spec = mappings[m]["target_species"].as<std::string>();
                    double frac = mappings[m]["mass_split_fraction"].as<double>();
                    
                    int target_idx = getSpeciesIndex(target_spec);
                    if (target_idx >= 0) {
                        auto& params = h_species_params(target_idx);
                        params.emissions_mapping.is_active = true;
                        params.emissions_mapping.raw_cece_index = raw_cece_idx;
                        params.emissions_mapping.mass_split_fraction = frac;
                        
                        if (mappings[m]["is_modal_mode"]) {
                            params.emissions_mapping.is_modal_mode = mappings[m]["is_modal_mode"].as<bool>();
                            params.emissions_mapping.emitted_particle_diameter = mappings[m]["emitted_particle_diameter"].as<double>();
                            params.emissions_mapping.lognormal_sigma = mappings[m]["lognormal_sigma"].as<double>();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
```

### Task 4: GPU Emissions Solver Kernel & Execution Adapter

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/src_impl/gocart/GocartSolver.cpp`
- Modify: `src/exaero/IAerosolPackage_C.cpp`
- Modify: `tests/test_main.cpp`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Mapped CECE raw views and environmental views.
- Produces: Correctly computed volumetric mass and number emissions rate arrays on the GPU.

- [ ] **Step 1: Implement `GocartEmissionsKernel` in `GocartSolver.cpp`**

Implement the high-performance Kokkos GPU kernel and its wrapper `run_gocart_emissions`:

```cpp
    void run_gocart_emissions(
        GocartSolverState* state,
        int num_cells, int num_levels, int num_raw_species, int num_target_species,
        int flux_type_code,
        const double* thick_ptr,
        const double* raw_emissions_ptr,
        double* target_emissions_out_ptr) {

        using MemSpace = Kokkos::DefaultExecutionSpace::memory_space;

        auto d_thick = Kokkos::View<const double**, Kokkos::LayoutLeft, MemSpace, Kokkos::MemoryTraits<Kokkos::Unmanaged>>(
            thick_ptr, num_cells, num_levels
        );
        auto d_raw = Kokkos::View<const double***, Kokkos::LayoutLeft, MemSpace, Kokkos::MemoryTraits<Kokkos::Unmanaged>>(
            raw_emissions_ptr, num_cells, num_levels, num_raw_species
        );
        auto d_out = Kokkos::View<double***, Kokkos::LayoutLeft, MemSpace, Kokkos::MemoryTraits<Kokkos::Unmanaged>>(
            target_emissions_out_ptr, num_cells, num_levels, num_target_species
        );

        auto d_species_params = state->d_species_params;

        Kokkos::parallel_for("GocartEmissions_Kernel",
            Kokkos::MDRangePolicy<Kokkos::Rank<3>>({0, 0, 0}, {num_cells, num_levels, num_target_species}),
            KOKKOS_LAMBDA(int i_cell, int i_level, int i_spec) {
                
                const auto& params = d_species_params(i_spec);
                const auto& map = params.emissions_mapping;
                
                if (!map.is_active || map.raw_cece_index < 0 || map.raw_cece_index >= num_raw_species) {
                    d_out(i_cell, i_level, i_spec) = 0.0;
                    return;
                }

                // 1. Fetch raw flux and clamp negative or NaN values
                double raw_flux = d_raw(i_cell, i_level, map.raw_cece_index);
                if (Kokkos::isnan(raw_flux) || !Kokkos::isfinite(raw_flux) || raw_flux < 0.0) {
                    raw_flux = 0.0;
                }

                // 2. Perform Unit Scaling (Area Flux -> Volumetric)
                double vol_mass_flux = 0.0;
                if (flux_type_code == 1) { // AREA_FLUX
                    double dz = d_thick(i_cell, i_level);
                    if (dz > 1e-12) {
                        vol_mass_flux = raw_flux / dz;
                    } else {
                        vol_mass_flux = 0.0; // Avoid division-by-zero on micro layers
                    }
                } else { // MASS_CONCENTRATION_RATE
                    vol_mass_flux = raw_flux;
                }

                // 3. Apply mass split fraction
                double final_mass_rate = vol_mass_flux * map.mass_split_fraction;

                // 4. Handle Modal Number Conversion if applicable
                if (map.is_modal_mode && map.emitted_particle_diameter > 1e-12) {
                    double ln_sig = Kokkos::log(map.lognormal_sigma);
                    double vol_factor = (M_PI / 6.0) * params.dry_density * 
                                        Kokkos::pow(map.emitted_particle_diameter, 3) * 
                                        Kokkos::exp(4.5 * ln_sig * ln_sig);
                    
                    if (vol_factor > 1e-30) {
                        d_out(i_cell, i_level, i_spec) = final_mass_rate / vol_factor; // Emitted Number concentration
                    } else {
                        d_out(i_cell, i_level, i_spec) = 0.0;
                    }
                } else {
                    d_out(i_cell, i_level, i_spec) = final_mass_rate; // Standard mass rate
                }
            }
        );
        Kokkos::fence();
    }
```
